dedupe_keys.name: azerbaijan digital development telecommunications and ict statistics of the ministry of digital development and transport

description: Azerbaijan Digital Development is the statistical section of the Ministry of Digital Development and Transport of Azerbaijan, which regulates telecommunications, post, broadcasting, spectrum and transport. The section read on 2026-09-28 presents statistics from 1980 onwards in chapters on the fixed telephone network, the mobile cellular network, traffic, the internet network, ICT infrastructure and access, ICT indicators for households, computer access and use, ICT use by households, individuals and enterprises, television broadcasting and quality of service, trade in ICT products, ICT in education, other indicators and prices, revenue and investment, and telecom sector employees. Coverage is national. Access is free to read as web tables; no licence is stated. Caveats: tables are national aggregates without network geography, and definitions follow ITU indicators that may change over the series. It supports capacity planning and trend analysis of Azerbaijani telecom and broadcast networks. Related record: data-crc-mongolia-mobile-coverage-map-kml is a comparable regional telecom regulator source.
